about.name: I'm <1>Alina</1> Groza
about.bio: Frontend developer with commercial experience at Akor Direct. I build web applications with React and TypeScript. At Get Together, I developed chat and notification modules using Socket.IO. In the Starlions team project, I implemented photo publishing and profile management. My work includes responsive interfaces, reusable components, and REST API integrations.
